lean.note: In this proposed reduction to RH, each sufficiently large scale $x$ requires at least $\sqrt{x}$ lifts, a bound for the weighted character sums, and a bad-prime error of order $x^{1/2+\varepsilon}$. The implication is outside the final dependency cone.
